import os, hmac, hashlib, base64, pathlib, sys
body_path = pathlib.Path('/inputs/body.json')
out_path = pathlib.Path('/work/hmac.txt')
secret = os.environ.get('SHOPIFY_API_SECRET')
if secret is None:
    print('ERROR: SHOPIFY_API_SECRET not set')
    sys.exit(1)
body = body_path.read_bytes()
digest = hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
val = base64.b64encode(digest).decode('ascii')
out_path.write_text(val + '\n', encoding='ascii', newline='')
# verify exact format ascii and trailing newline
raw = out_path.read_bytes()
print('WROTE', out_path)
print('BYTES_LEN', len(raw))
print('ENDS_NEWLINE', raw.endswith(b'\n'))
print('NONASCII', any(b>127 for b in raw))
